description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Invincible General], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Ice, Holy)] and [Unleashed Runic Blade Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Invincible General
description.text: Holy and Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Holy] after using a Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Unleashed Runic Blade Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Unleashed Runic Blade after using two Ice or Holy abilities
